freeHelp.title: Complain about a legal adviser - GOV.UK
freeHelp.blurb:
Summary:
- This GOV.UK page explains how to complain about a legal adviser and when to contact the Legal Ombudsman.
- Steps: follow your adviser’s own complaints procedure first; ask them for a copy of it.
- If you’re unhappy with their response or they don’t respond within 8 weeks, you can escalate to the Legal Ombudsman.
- Legal Ombudsman contact (UK): 0300 555 0333, Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm. Addr
